summary: RedHill Biopharma filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release about enforcement of an $11 million New York Supreme Court final judgment against Kukbo Co. Ltd. The filing describes legal proceedings to recognize and enforce the judgment in Korea, not a corporate transaction. No deal terms, acquisition, divestiture, or other special situation event is involved. This is a routine legal update on judgment enforcement, not a special situation as defined.
